name: B10-0525/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Rule of law and human rights situation in Tunisia, particularly the case of Sonia Dahmani
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the rule of law and human rights situation in Tunisia, particularly the case of Sonia Dahmani
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of Sonia Dahmani, a Tunisian lawyer and writer jailed for speaking out. It says her trial was unfair and her prison conditions are cruel. It asks Tunisia to drop the charges against her and other political prisoners, and to stop cracking down on free speech. It also asks the European Union to tie its financial support for Tunisia to real progress on human rights and democracy.

- The Parliament demands Dahmani's release and an end to charges against political prisoners.
- It asks the European Union to link aid to Tunisia to human rights progress.
- It calls on European Union countries to condemn Tunisia's crackdown and help activists at risk.
